summary: Iteration 2 testing complete. All 28 backend pytest tests pass (18 from iter1 + 10 new). Full frontend smoke covering rebrand, hotkeys, reorder page, scanner presets/mode memory, inventory new columns — every checkpoint passed.
critical_code_review_comments: Reorder suggestions endpoint enriches every product on every call (N x usage aggregation). Fine for ~10 products but will degrade once catalog grows — consider a single MongoDB aggregation pipeline grouping movements by product_id once.
list_products with with_usage also does N+1 movement queries; same future-scaling concern.

/api/orders/{id}/status uses existing.get('status') != 'received' to gate stock-add — this is correct and idempotent, verified by tests. But there is no protection against transitioning from 'received' back to 'sent' and then to 'received' again, which would re-add stock. Consider rejecting status changes out of 'received'.
server.py is 730 lines, single-file; would benefit from splitting into routers (products, orders, reorder, etc.) per file-size guideline once it grows further.
CORS allows '*' by default and credentials=True together — browsers reject this combination; OK since no auth, but worth tightening when packaging as Electron.
seed_data_creation: Used existing /api/seed (idempotent). Did NOT create permanent test data; all TEST_* records cleaned up after each test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test suites: /app/backend/tests/test_backend_api.py (iter1 baseline) + /app/backend/tests/test_iteration2.py (with_usage, reorder suggestions/auto, dashboard extras, idempotent receive). Run with: pytest /app/backend/tests/ -v. Frontend hotkeys S/I/C/A confirmed; scanner mode key in localStorage is 'mspf-scan-mode'. Reorder route is /commander, page testid 'reorder-page', supplier group testid prefix 'supplier-group-', generate btn testid 'generate-orders-btn'. Note: list_products (without with_usage) returns plain dicts, not Product schema — older field strict checks may need updating if added.
